title: Clicking a time in a message shows it on the calendar before any event form
steps: Launch with -UseFakeData -UseFakeCalendar and open a conversation that mentions a day and time
Check the time is underlined, then click it
Press the previous and next day arrows (or − and =), come back to the day, then click the block
Press Cancel in the new event card
expected: The calendar opens on that day with the time as a Create event block; over an event it takes the free right part and the event's title stays readable, with a Busy then line. The arrows change the day; the block stays on its own day. Clicking it opens a filled-in card over the day that fits the panel, scrolls and always shows Save and Cancel; Cancel brings the block back.
